speaker: 美美
source_display: 喂,阿文,你識唔識跳舞呀?
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Wai3, Aa3 Man4, nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 tiu3 mou5 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_display: 識少少啫,跳得唔係好好。
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Sik1 siu2 siu2 ze1, tiu3 dak1 m4 hai6 hou2 hou2.

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Nei5 sik1 tiu3 me1 mou5 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_display: 我識跳啲基本嘅舞,好似華爾滋咁。
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Ngo5 sik1 tiu3 di1 gei1 bun2 ge3 mou5, hou2 ci5 Waa4 Ji5 Zi1 gam2.

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Waa1, Waa4 Ji5 Zi1! Nei5 gei2 si4 hok6 gaa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_display: 我上年學咗三個月,不過而家唔記得晒喇。
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Ngo5 soeng6 nin4 hok6 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6, bat1 gwo3 ji4 gaa1 m4 gei3 dak1 saai3 laa3.

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Dim2 gaai2 m4 gai3 zuk6 tiu3 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Jan1 wai6 taai3 mong4 laa3, mou5 si4 gaan3.

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Gam2 nei5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Jau5 aa3, dim2 gaai2 gam3 man6 aa3?

speaker: 美美
source_display: 我想學跳舞,你可唔可以教我呀?
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Ngo5 soeng2 hok6 tiu3 mou5, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gaau3 ngo5 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_display: 我教得唔好㗎,不如你去學校學啦。
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Ngo5 gaau3 dak1 m4 hou2 gaa3, bat1 jyu4 nei5 heoi3 hok6 haau6 hok6 laa1.

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Ngo5 geng1 hok6 haau6 taai3 gwai3 laa3.

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Gam2 nei5 soeng2 hok6 di1 me1 mou5 aa3?

speaker: 美美
source_display: 我想學爵士舞,你識唔識呀?
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Ngo5 soeng2 hok6 Zoek6 Si6 Mou5, nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_display: 唔識呀,我淨係識跳華爾滋。
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: M4 sik1 aa3, ngo5 zing6 hai6 sik1 tiu3 Waa4 Ji5 Zi1.

speaker: 美美
source_display: 咁你可唔可以陪我去睇下呀?
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Gam2 nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 pui4 ngo5 heoi3 tai2 haa5 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Heoi3 bin1 dou6 tai2 aa3?

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Heoi3 tiu3 mou5 hok6 haau6 tai2 haa5 fo3 cing4.

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Dak1 aa3, gei2 si4 heoi3 aa3?

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Ting1 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_display: 得呀,聽日下晝得唔得呀?
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Dak1 aa3, ting1 jat6 haa6 zau3 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Dak1 aa3! Gam2 ngo5 dei6 joek3 gei2 dim2 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Saam1 dim2 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Dak1 aa3! Hai2 bin1 dou6 gin3 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Hai2 hok6 haau6 mun4 hau2 gin3 laa1.

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Hou2 aa3! Gam2 hok6 haau6 giu3 me1 meng2 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_display: 叫「星光舞蹈學校」,你識唔識呀?
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Giu3 "Sing1 Gwong1 Mou5 Dou6 Hok6 Haau6", nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 aa3?

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: M4 sik1 aa3, hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Hai2 Wong6 Gok3 dou6, hou2 kan5 dei6 tit3 zaam6.

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Hou2 aa3, gam2 ngo5 wan2 dou2 laa3!

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Gei3 zyu6 zoek3 wan6 dung6 haai4 aa3!

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Hou2 aa3, ngo5 gei3 zyu6 laa3!

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: Gam2 ting1 jat6 gin3 laa3!

speaker: 美美
source_jyutping: Mei5 Mei5: Ting1 jat6 gin3! Do1 ze6 nei5 aa3!

speaker: 阿文
source_jyutping: Aa3 Man4: M4 sai2 haak3 hei3!
